mod.litematica_chunk_aligner.name: Litematica Chunk Aligner
config.litematica_chunk_aligner.enableSn: Whether Litematica placement origin snaps automatically based on chosen mode.
config.litematica_chunk_aligner.snapMode: Sub-chunk 16x16x16, Farm Perimeter bounding box, or Nether Portal 8:1 linking grid.
config.litematica_chunk_aligner.snapAnch: Anchor origin for snapping (North-West Min corner, South-East Max corner, or Horizontally Centered).
config.litematica_chunk_aligner.snapSubC: Clamp vertical Y coordinate to multiples of 16 (e.g., -64, -48, -32, -16, 0, 16...).
config.litematica_chunk_aligner.enableSl: Visualizes green wireframe bounding boxes over valid slime spawning chunks.
config.litematica_chunk_aligner.worldSee: Manual world seed for multiplayer servers where the client cannot query /seed directly.
config.litematica_chunk_aligner.renderDi: Radius in chunks around the player to check and render slime chunk wireframes.
config.litematica_chunk_aligner.slimeMin: Bottom boundary for slime spawning overlay box (default -64).
config.litematica_chunk_aligner.slimeMax: Top boundary for slime spawning overlay box (default 40).
config.litematica_chunk_aligner.renderFu: Draw vertical pillar guidelines extending through world height up to Y 320.
config.litematica_chunk_aligner.portalSe: Nether search radius for portal frame linking (default 128 blocks = 16 chunks).
config.litematica_chunk_aligner.enforceS: Ensures entire portal frame stays within 1 chunk to prevent cross-chunk lag & ticket leaks.
config.litematica_chunk_aligner.farmPadd: Additional chunk margin around farm bounding box for perimeter walls and lighting.
config.litematica_chunk_aligner.renderDe: Visualizes hostile mob despawn boundary around calculated AFK position.
message.litematica_chunk_aligner.no_plac: No active Litematica placement selected to snap.
message.litematica_chunk_aligner.seed_se: Slime chunk world seed set to %s
message.litematica_chunk_aligner.farm_al: Farm Perimeter: %d chunks (%dx%d blocks). AFK origin: [%d, %d, %d]
